verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is HMRC's employer-registration page saying you can check when to expect your registration letter from HMRC. That is a first-party, service-published wait-time expectation for one transaction type, but the pack never shows the actual figures or similar timings for other registrations. missing for 10: published processing times for VAT and Corporation Tax registration and MTD sign-up, evidence that times are current or regularly updated, the actual stated timeframes, independent corroboration.
